description: This file defines the EmailCampaignDomainServiceImpl class, which manages email campaign logic related to loan events such as approval, rejection, and repayment. It registers event listeners and handles sending emails based on specific business events by retrieving relevant email campaigns and invoking the email platform service.

classes.name: EmailCampaignDomainServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the EmailCampaignDomainService interface, responsible for managing email campaigns triggered by loan-related business events.

methods.name: addListeners
methods.description: Initializes event listeners for loan approved, rejected, and repayment events.

methods.name: notifyLoanOwner
methods.description: Retrieves email campaigns and sends emails for loan transactions or loans, formatted with relevant parameters.

methods.name: retrieveEmailCampaigns
methods.description: Fetches active email campaigns based on a trigger type and a parameter value.
